rom._md5_source: world source: worlds/soulblazer/Rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- `USHASH = "83cf41d53a1b94aeea1a645037a24004"`, used as `hash` on SoulBlazerProcedurePatch, i.e. the dump the world validates the player's file against.

client.name: SNI Client
client._source: SCHEMA rule 1, read from the world itself: worlds/soulblazer/Client.py, 2026-08-23 -- `class SoulBlazerSNIClient(SNIClient)`. ⚠ The setup guide is NOT usable for this: its connection section still tells the player about "the Donkey Kong Country 3 Client", which is a copy-paste left in the author's guide. The world's own code was used instead. ⚠ Recording the world's OWN transport. London does not run upstream's client -- see catalog/games/smw.json, where an SNIClient world is driven by a BizHawk RAM map instead and the protocol was set to bizhawk for that reason. Whoever writes this game's RAM map must set the protocol to match the bridge the map actually targets. ⚠ Rule 2 is NOT satisfied: no RAM map Plugins/Scripts/games/soul_blazer.lua exists, so the build refuses this manifest.
client._kind_source: The world subclasses Archipelago's own SNI client (SNIClient / SNIContext / snes_read), so AP's "SNI Client" component drives it over SNI -- there is no client of its own to register and nothing for London to write. Read out of the package's source 27 Aug 2026.

apworld._source: catalog/sheet_links.json, the "APWorld, Emotracker" link for SoulBlazer. ⚠ Note this is a DIFFERENT repository from the one that holds the source and the guide (Tranquilite0/Archipelago-SoulBlazer); the sheet and catalog/sheet_survey.json both point releases at Tranquilite0/Archipelago. The guide names no source at all.

patch._source: world source: worlds/soulblazer/Rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- `class SoulBlazerProcedurePatch(APProcedurePatch, APTokenMixin)` with `patch_file_ending = ".apsb"`. The guide agrees: double-clicking the `.apsb` file creates the ROM beside it.

_patch_extension_source: world source: worlds/soulblazer/Rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- the world defines `SoulBlazerPatchExtensions`, an APPatchExtension subclass, with the single method `apply_patches`. That is a NEW step name, not one of the generic set (apply_bsdiff4, apply_tokens, copy, calc_snes_crc, apply_ips, apply_xdelta), so London's patcher refuses it loudly and the game would play unpatched -- the safe failure, not the silent one.
